lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of low-contrast, circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in approximately three to four semi-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, extending toward the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal blob rows, creating a subtle grid-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a subtle light-to-shadow vertical gradient, running parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.
